title: [codex] Physically lower delayed-cover split, child shapes and return
body:
## Result

This physically lowers two concrete delayed-cover interfaces: the low-type split/return address map of #5829, and the previously supplied child-shape grants at one actual continuation edge. It changes no paid profile, kappa, selected-frontier file or framework-assumption status. Scientific admission remains pending.

For each fixed `L>=2`, literal programs on **L+7 tapes** split an arbitrary `(a,l,r)` bit stream into L complete banks and merge arbitrary changed child outputs into their original addresses. Positive A,R are binary tape inputs. For `V=A*L*R`, the written unbounded proof gives **time<=94V and visited space<=13V**, including setup, head return and scratch/marker erasure. Entry backing is charged separately.

A second literal nine-tape program reads the actual binary parent A, common H and parent R headers and produces

```
A_child=A/(L*H), R_child=H*R
```

on the stated complete-batch domain `L*H | A`. A fixed jump directly connects its emitted table to the unchanged child router on **L+11 tapes**. Its payload is one parent bank of size A*R=V/L, with the exact inherited high/ancestor address identity. No runtime host multiplication, division, decoded integer, variable tape index or interpreter callback supplies either child grant. The raw linked table plus actual output consumers has conservative all-size bounds **1000V transitions /100V visited cells**. These constants are not asserted for the entire codec/continuation pipeline.

The existing physical stack composition is also exercised with the grants genuinely generated before the root's first suspension. A real `B2,N1,q3,w2,L4,H3` case uses **28 fixed tapes**, produces child A1/R9 from parent A12/R3 and runs both smaller child continuations. Changed child data is relayed **before destructive pop**, then replaces the occupied parent bank. The complete 144-bit root case measures **93096 read/write/unit-move actions**, including grant generation, coded-scratch erasure, both returns, root-output consumption and final grant erasure. The bit-complement semantic leaf is explicit.

## Limits and overlap

H remains a physical input header. H-from-width, numerical ancestor weights, arbitrary-depth production descriptors/traversal, Gaussian children, routes/fallbacks and precision remain open. This is a source-bound physical interface implementation, not a complete multiplication algorithm or a discharge of the five assumptions.

Ali Romman's #5829 already supplies the whole-high map, divisor, ancestor-weight independence and geometric allocation. David Arias's #2776 supplies the unchanged finite machine/assembler/counter. The retained stack, codec and return authors supply suspension and output relay. Jose Manuel's selected-binary-control and the binary-divisor predecessor already provide generic arithmetic/weight routines. Those are credited and not reintroduced as new theorems. The added value is the emitted interface and its direct source-bound physical connection. No world-priority claim is made.

## Reproduction and validation

Python3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/delayed-cover-physical-batch-routing
```

Eight registered commands execute ten scientific replays: the original six core/separate-interpreter/composition checks are unchanged; two mode-specific drivers each run the shape verifier and its separate transition walker. All pass in normal and optimized mode. Thirty generic source pins resolve to the canonical base or reachable own ancestors; exact retained bytes are authenticated before import.

- Core:110 arbitrary-data/descriptor fixtures, actual #5829 maps and semantic controls.
- Separate router interpreter:198 routing and256 converter cases, without executing source Machine/Tape classes.
- Retained physical composition:33 cases, real H2/H3 updates,24-tape L9 control and1303487 physical actions.
- Shape producer:12 arithmetic/linked fixtures plus the actual28-tape generated-grant continuation above.
- Separate shape interpreter:256 producer cases,32 directly linked child splits and5 rejecting controls; exact input/head/prefix preservation and charged scratch/grant/copy retirement. It executes neither source Machine nor Tape and binds its snapshot to the active producer.

Final head `3bad39ffd4faf7e8cb1bc5b47769cbb28511f797` passed a Git-free export/replay of all91 committed files in3.901s, with all inputs byte-identical afterward. The [registered upstream workflow](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41908845855) passed on that exact head: all eight commands/ten scientific replays and the committed-input cleanliness guard. Each of the30 declared source refs, paths, Git blobs, SHA256 values and ancestor relations was checked directly; the optional full-history helper was unavailable in the shallow local checkout and was not run by this workflow.

Finite tests corroborate the written inductions and exact/coarse bills; they are not the unbounded proof. Implementations and separate reviews are author-side AI-assisted evidence, not external scientific acceptance. Historical native, selected supplier, Lean and Docker suites were not rerun.

Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex and parallel-agent assistance. Original notices remain exact; Apache-2.0. The intended lane is scoped validated research.
